name: WIDAD
recent: Widad Group Berhad 近期面对多项法律与清盘相关事项：其子公司 Widad Builders Sdn Bhd 遭 ST Tunnel (M) 提出清盘呈请，随后已全额偿还 199 万令吉应付款项；同时公司本身对 Dataprep 提出清盘呈请，追讨未偿债务。最新季度（2026年9月30日止）净利为 119 万令吉，但年初至今营收下滑 28.82%。
notable: 子公司 Widad Builders Sdn Bhd 遭 ST Tunnel (M) 提出清盘呈请，涉及未付款项。
公司已全额偿还 199 万令吉应付款项予 ST Tunnel (M)。
Widad Group 对 Dataprep 提出清盘呈请，追讨未偿债务。
risks: 子公司 Widad Builders Sdn Bhd 面对 ST Tunnel (M) 的清盘呈请。
公司对 Dataprep 提出清盘呈请，涉及未偿债务追讨。
2026年9月1日多名董事及委员会成员变动。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为 2415.5 万令吉，环比下降 10.8%，同比下降 29.7%；净利为 95 万令吉，环比下降 8.0%，同比增长 57.8%；净利率为 3.9%。最新季度（2026年9月30日止）净利为 119 万令吉，年初至今营收下滑 28.82%。

recent_en: Widad Group Berhad has recently faced several legal and winding-up matters: its subsidiary Widad Builders Sdn Bhd was hit by a winding-up petition from ST Tunnel (M), which was subsequently fully settled with a RM1.99 million payment; meanwhile, the company itself filed a winding-up petition against Dataprep over unpaid debt. The latest quarter ended 30 September 2026 recorded a net profit of RM1.19 million, despite a 28.82% year-to-date revenue decline.
notable_en: Subsidiary Widad Builders Sdn Bhd was hit by a winding-up petition from ST Tunnel (M) over unpaid sums.
The company fully settled RM1.99 million payable to ST Tunnel (M).
Widad Group filed a winding-up petition against Dataprep over unpaid debt.
risks_en: Subsidiary Widad Builders Sdn Bhd faces a winding-up petition from ST Tunnel (M).
The company filed a winding-up petition against Dataprep to recover unpaid debt.
Several board and committee changes occurred on 1 September 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM24.155 million, down 10.8% QoQ and 29.7% YoY; net profit was RM0.95 million, down 8.0% QoQ but up 57.8% YoY; net margin was 3.9%. The latest quarter ended 30 September 2026 recorded a net profit of RM1.19 million, with year-to-date revenue down 28.82%.
